title: Horse Power: Sonny Drops the Week-High 142.46 as Three Teams Hit 2-0
dek: The Horse is Hea ran over JMoney, No Banner only HULK kept bullying, Philly finally got on the board, and the bottom of the table got very crowded at 0-2.
body: Last week Sonny squeaked past Team Pillbert by four points and the title model shrugged at him. This week The Horse is Hea answered with the biggest number on the board, a 142.46 to 82.08 flattening of Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV, and a 60.38-point margin that was the largest of the week. Jaxon Smith-Njigba did the heavy lifting with 38 points on a 15.22 projection, the second-best individual score in the league. The truly rude part: Sonny did all of this with Patrick Mahomes and his 28.98 points sitting on the bench. The model finally took notice, bumping The Horse is Hea from 4% to 10% title odds, which is still somehow behind a 1-1 team, but we'll get to that.

Ramon's No. 1-ranked No Banner only HULK is now doing this on a weekly basis. Brucie handled Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN 131.92 to 82.8, with Josh Allen posting 40.82 on a 22.65 projection, the top performance of the week and 76.48 points across his first two games. The HULK has 309.8 points for, nearly 40 more than anyone else, and the model now gives them 54% title odds and a 100% playoff chance after two weeks, which feels like the computer simply giving up. Even the bench is flexing: Matthew Stafford (26.98) and Travis Kelce (20.6) combined for 47.58 points in reserve, a sentence that should worry the other seven managers more than it worries Ramon.

For Z², the follow-up to her debut win was a tough lesson in how fast this game turns. Saquon Barkley went for 2.5 on a 16.38 projection, and against the league's hottest offense there was no climbing out of that. Ghostu-Spider SZN fell from 13% to 1% title odds, the steepest drop of the week, though at 1-1 with 24% playoff odds the season is very much alive. Zoey grabbed Devaughn Vele off the wire without dropping anyone, a quiet depth move that says she's already thinking about the long haul.

Philly got his first win of 2026 and got it loudly. Team Pillbert beat Habibsters 135.48 to 109.66 in what the pregame odds called a coin flip, and Davante Adams turned it into a rout with 35.5 points on a 13.14 projection. Alan was busy on the wire too, adding Jalen Coker for Tony Pollard and swapping Sam LaPorta out for Isaiah Likely, and the model rewarded the whole package by vaulting Team Pillbert from 4% to 13% title odds. That's higher than Sonny's 10%, despite the worse record, which tells you the computer believes in this roster more than the standings do.

Habib, meanwhile, had a week that's hard to explain in a straight line. CeeDee Lamb (31.3) and Dak Prescott (29.76) both delivered big, but Puka Nacua sat in the starting lineup and did not play, a zero that's on the manager, not the receiver, in a game Kaushal lost by 25.82. Then came the waiver carousel: Jaguars D/ST out for the Buccaneers, Buccaneers out for the 49ers, 49ers out for the Buccaneers again, plus Deebo Samuel Sr. added for Wan'Dale Robinson and then dropped for Wan'Dale Robinson. Five transactions, and the net result is one defense swap and the same receiver he started with. The Habibsters are 0-2 with 15% playoff odds, and the two-time champ needs a win more than he needs another D/ST.

Randy's The fumblers are 2-0 after a 124.02 to 100.74 win over Mekhi's Dawgs, powered by Amon-Ra St. Brown's 30.7. The asterisk is under center: Caleb Williams, last week's top scorer, cratered to 7.72 on a 19.42 projection, and the model actually dropped Randy from 28% to 21% title odds after a win. Kai is now 0-2 with 9% playoff odds, and he went back to the wire for Kenyon Sadiq at Carnell Tate's expense, hoping the waiver magic kicks in sooner rather than later. JMoney, sadly, has the toughest climb of anyone: Malik Nabers posted 0.6 on a 12.26 projection, Counting or not Counting GV has 158 points through two weeks, 41 behind the next-lowest team, and the playoff odds sit at 1%.

The table has split cleanly: three 2-0 teams on top, Team Pillbert and Ghostu-Spider SZN in the 1-1 middle, and three 0-2 teams at the bottom. Week 3 tests both ends. Habib gets the HULK, which is either the worst possible draw or the perfect spot for a two-time champ to remind everyone who he is. Zoe hosts Randy in the first Bears-versus-Packers meeting of her fantasy career, Sonny takes on a Dawgs team that needs a win badly, and Philly faces JMoney looking to stack his second straight win. Twelve weeks of regular season left, and the bottom three already know exactly how loud the clock is.

social.author: Buckaroo Football League
social.text: Week 2 final: The Horse is Hea 142.46, Counting or not Counting GV 82.08. Team Pillbert 135.48, Habibsters 109.66. No Banner only HULK 131.92, Ghostu-Spider SZN 82.8. The fumblers 124.02, Dawgs 100.74. Three teams remain unbeaten at 2-0.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: 142.46 and the top score of the week. Player of the week: Jaxon Smith-Njigba with 38 points. 2-0 and galloping into week 3. 🐎

social.author: Marcus Pell
social.text: The model has Team Pillbert at 13% and The Horse is Hea at 10%. One of those teams is 2-0 and just posted the week-high with Mahomes on the bench. I'd take the horse.

social.author: Bench Points Betty
social.text: Ramon left 47.58 points on the bench (Stafford 26.98, Kelce 20.6) and still won by 49. Sonny benched Mahomes' 28.98 and still won by 60. The rich get richer.

social.author: Waiver Wire Wendell
social.text: Habibsters this week: Jags D to Bucs D to Niners D to Bucs D. Deebo in, Deebo out, Wan'Dale back. Five moves to end up basically where he started. Respect the cardio.

social.author: Start Sit Stan
social.text: Two weeks, two inactive players in starting lineups. This week it was Puka Nacua for the Habibsters. Check. The. Inactives.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN Fan Club
social.text: Saquon 2.5 points. We don't talk about it. 1-1, Vele added, and the fumblers come to town next. Cheese stays undefeated in our hearts. 🕷️

social.author: Lakefront Larry
social.text: Caleb went from 37.26 to 7.72 in one week and Randy still won by 23. Amon-Ra carrying the Bears QB's luggage like a true Lions gentleman.

bios.1: Sonny's crew is 2-0 after the week's top score, a 142.46 blowout led by Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 38. Title odds jumped from 4% to 10%, and that's with Mahomes' 28.98 stuck on the bench. The lineup decisions are the only thing slowing this team down.
bios.2: Randy is 2-0 and second in points at 270.2, winning this week even with Caleb Williams laying a 7.72. Amon-Ra St. Brown picked up the slack, but the model dipped them from 28% to 21% title odds. A visit from the Packers fan in the league looms.
bios.3: Jordan is 0-2 with a league-low 158 points, and Malik Nabers' 0.6 this week said it all. Playoff odds are down to 1%, and the gap to seventh place in scoring is 41 points. JMoney needs a big week against Team Pillbert to change the soundtrack.
bios.4: Philly is 1-1 after a 135.48 statement over the Habibsters, fueled by Davante Adams' 35.5. Two waiver swaps and one big win were enough to push Team Pillbert's title odds from 4% to 13%, ahead of a couple of unbeaten teams. JMoney is next in line.
bios.5: Mekhi's Dawgs are 0-2 after a 124.02 to 100.74 loss to the fumblers, with playoff odds down to 9%. Kai went back to the wire for Kenyon Sadiq, hoping a fresh face sparks the turnaround. A 2-0 Horse is Hea awaits.
bios.6: Kaushal is 0-2 despite 218.3 points, more than two teams with better records. Lamb and Dak showed up, an inactive Puka in the lineup didn't help, and a five-move waiver spree mostly went in circles. Playoff odds sit at 15% with the league leader on deck.
bios.7: Ramon's juggernaut is 2-0 with a league-best 309.8 points and the model has handed it 54% title odds and a 100% playoff chance. Josh Allen has 76.48 points in two weeks, and the bench is good enough to start for most teams. Next up: a two-time champ looking for his first win.
bios.8: Zoe's rookie season hit its first speed bump with an 82.8-point loss to the HULK, as Saquon Barkley managed just 2.5. At 1-1 with 24% playoff odds, the season is far from over, and Devaughn Vele joins the roster. Randy and the fumblers are up next.
